newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel estimates raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Robert Chaplinsky raised his 1997 earnings estimate for Intel Corp to $8.75 a share from $7.81 a share and revenue estimate to $27.47 billion from $25.1 billion.
-- On Tuesday, Intel reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $2.13 and revenues of $6.4 billion, beating Chaplinsky's estimate of $1.86 a share and $6.0 billion, respectively.
-- Chaplinsky maintains a buy rating on Intel stock, and in a written statement said Intel's "outlook remains very strong."
